title: Quantum corrections to the Casimir effect in a scalar Hořava-Lifshitz theory with rough plates at low temperature
summary: We investigate the Casimir effect of a massive, self-interacting real scalar field with quartic coupling in a $(3+1)$-dimensional Hořava-Lifshitz-type theory, subject to rough boundaries obeying Dirichlet boundary conditions. Using the effective action and generalized $ζ$-function approach, we derive the renormalized effective potential, incorporating anisotropic scaling, boundary roughness, and temperature in the low-temperature regime.
